title: Annulment of Bengal Partition
subtitle: Reversal of the 1905 partition after sustained political mobilization.
summary: In 1911, the British government annulled the 1905 partition of Bengal and reunited Bengal as a single province. The reversal followed years of protest, boycott, and political mobilization, while also introducing a new imperial administrative order with the transfer of the capital from Calcutta to Delhi.
heroTagline: The annulment marked both a political concession and a strategic imperial reconfiguration.
whyItMatters: The 1911 annulment showed how sustained public pressure could reshape colonial decisions, while leaving unresolved tensions over representation, communal politics, and regional power that continued into later decades.
